I18N-0 foundation boundaries > fixes the Vitest default locale to zh-Hant
I18N-0 foundation boundaries > uses no detector loader Suspense or dynamic resource import
I18N-0 foundation boundaries > renders no language selector autonym or planned locale affordance
I18N-0 foundation boundaries > keeps bootstrap reads separate from authority reconciliation and cache writes
I18N-0 foundation boundaries > records the exact I18N-1 migrated scopes and sole ArkScope allowlist
I18N-0 foundation boundaries > records the exact I18N-2 migrated scopes and stable-value allowlist
I18N-0 foundation boundaries > closes remaining localization with global src scope and exact empty-debt arithmetic
I18N-0 foundation boundaries > keeps the public locale selector scoped to Settings and controller-backed
I18N-0 foundation boundaries > forbids dynamic Settings keys and direct normal-mode raw diagnostic sinks
UI locale cache > allowlists exactly zh-Hant and en
UI locale cache > treats a missing cache entry as absent
UI locale cache > ignores malformed and unknown cache values
UI locale cache > ignores storage read exceptions
UI locale cache > writes only valid locale values and tolerates cache write failure
locale controller > authoritative GET corrects runtime document and cache
locale controller > same-locale GET still refreshes the write-through cache once
locale controller > GET failure preserves bootstrap truth and performs no cache write
locale controller > PUT is optimistic but writes cache only after success
locale controller > PUT failure rolls back and exposes only the stable error code
locale controller > prevents overlapping locale writes
locale controller > late startup GET cannot override a newer successful PUT
locale controller > late startup GET cannot override rollback after a newer failed PUT
locale controller > coalesces coincident and StrictMode-style startup reconciliation
portfolio presentation > maps every Portfolio operation outcome in both locales
